title: Problem
问题
html:
Primary source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10988. Public status: arXiv preprint, 2026. Existing browser-agent benchmarks trade off realism, reproducibility, and scalability: live sites drift, hand-built sandboxes can be unrealistic, and manual curation is costly.

The evaluation object is task instruction, website files, ground truth, answer type, solution steps, browser actions, observations, final answer, and judge result. The feedback contract is validation replay and final-state or submitted-answer comparison against ground truth. This belongs in the collection as an auditable benchmark or environment surface; it is not by itself proof of deployable reliability, and training use should be inferred only where the paper explicitly releases data for that purpose.

一手来源：https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10988。公开状态是 arXiv preprint，年份为 2026。已有浏览器智能体评测常在真实性、可复现性和规模之间取舍：真实网站会漂移，人工沙箱容易失真，手工构造任务又很昂贵。

评测对象包括任务说明、网站文件、标准答案、答案类型、解题步骤、浏览器动作、观测、最终答案和评审结果。反馈契约是验证回放，以及最终状态或提交答案与标准答案的比较。它应作为可审计的浏览器环境评测面来读；它不是部署可靠性的证明，也不能说明生成网站完全等价于真实网站。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
One-sentence contribution: WebForge generates self-contained browser environments and WebForge-Bench tasks to evaluate browser agents without relying on drifting live websites. The central idea is an automated environment-generation pipeline with difficulty control, followed by validation and benchmark scoring.

The data object contains task instruction, domain and difficulty vector, website files, ground truth, solution steps, browser action, observation, final answer, judge result. Success is decided by the browser run reaches the expected final state or answer under the official judge and action budget. Closest comparisons are static web benchmarks, tool-use datasets, or code benchmarks in the same domain, but the direction label here is the concrete evaluation surface and its verifier rather than a general capability claim.

一句话贡献：WebForge 生成自包含浏览器环境和 WebForge-Bench 任务，用来在不依赖易漂移真实网站的情况下评测浏览器智能体。核心思路是用自动生成流水线构造网页环境和任务，再通过难度控制、验证回放和最终状态检查形成评测。

数据对象包含任务说明、领域和难度向量、网站文件、标准答案、解题步骤、浏览器动作、观测、最终答案和评审结果。成功条件是浏览器运行在动作预算内达到预期最终状态，或提交答案通过官方评审器。最接近的对比对象是静态网页评测和人工构造浏览器环境，但这里的方向标签应落在可复现环境生成与反馈契约上。

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs are Plan-Generate-Refine-Validate pipeline creates task instructions and self-contained websites. Outputs are task instruction, website files, ground truth, answer type, solution steps, browser actions, observations, final answer, and judge result. The substrate is self-contained static websites served locally and executed in Chromium-like browser evaluation.

Pipeline: 1. construct or load the task instance; 2. run the model or system under the official harness; 3. collect actions, observations, answers, or predicted structures; 4. apply validation replay and final-state or submitted-answer comparison against ground truth; 5. aggregate scores only under a pinned version of the benchmark. Reproducibility requires pinning paper=https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.10988, project=https://github.com/yuandaxia2001/WebForge, code=https://github.com/yuandaxia2001/WebForge, data=https://huggingface.co/datasets/yuandaxia/WebForge, plus the exact split, runtime, scorer, prompt/scaffold, and release revision.

输入来自 Plan、Generate、Refine、Validate 生成流水线创建的任务和自包含网站。输出包括任务说明、网站文件、标准答案、答案类型、解题步骤、浏览器动作、观测、最终答案和评审结果。底层环境是本地服务的静态网页，并在 Chromium 一类浏览器运行框架中执行。

流程可以压缩成五步：1. 生成或载入任务与网页环境；2. 让被测浏览器智能体执行任务；3. 收集动作、观测和最终答案；4. 用验证回放、最终状态比较或提交答案比较进行评分；5. 只在固定版本的 benchmark 下聚合分数。复现时必须固定 arXiv 论文、GitHub 代码、Hugging Face 数据、划分、浏览器运行时、动作预算、提示或脚手架和评审器版本。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The arXiv abstract reports 934 tasks across 7 domains and 3 difficulty levels, with multi-model experiments showing that difficulty and domain stratification reveal capability profiles hidden by a single aggregate score.

Instance-level evidence comes from the released task object and the scorer: validation replay and final-state or submitted-answer comparison against ground truth. Aggregate scores are meaningful only for the reported split, model setup, and harness. Public artifacts support inspection, but they do not remove contamination, dependency, or license checks.

arXiv 摘要报告了 934 个任务、7 个领域和 3 个难度层级，并指出分领域和分难度分析能暴露单一总分看不出的能力差异。

样本级证据来自释放的任务对象、网站文件、标准答案和评审器：系统检查浏览器运行后的最终状态或提交答案是否匹配目标。聚合分数只对论文报告的划分、模型设置和运行框架成立。公开工件便于复查，但不能自动消除污染、依赖版本和许可风险。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The novelty is not browser automation itself; it is binding automated website generation, validation, and difficulty-controlled benchmark release into a reproducible environment surface.

The prior-work baseline is narrower task lists, static benchmarks, or less stateful evaluation surfaces. What changes is the combination of task object, environment or data substrate, and feedback contract. What is not new is benchmarking or model scoring in general. Before reuse, inspect split policy, release license, artifact revision, scorer implementation, prompt/scaffold, and whether public examples have entered training data.

新意不在“浏览器自动化”本身，而在把网页环境生成、验证和难度控制绑定成可复现的环境评测面。

已有基线通常是更窄的任务列表、静态 benchmark 或状态更弱的评测面。这里变化的是任务对象、环境或数据基底，以及反馈契约的组合。并不新的部分是做模型评测本身。复用前要检查划分策略、发布许可、工件版本、评分器实现、提示或脚手架，以及公开样本是否已经进入训练数据。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Generated sites can still miss live-web noise, and results depend on browser runtime, generated-site revision, action budget, and judge implementation.

Correctness is only relative to the released verifier or environment. A passing score may hide semantic failures outside the checked state, unobserved paths, tool/API drift, judge bias, public-task contamination, or scaffold-specific shortcuts. Do not read the benchmark as a universal verifier or as a reward signal without a separate audit.

生成网站仍可能缺少真实网站中的噪声，分数也依赖浏览器运行时、网站版本、动作预算和评审器实现。

正确性只相对于已释放的验证器或环境成立。通过分数可能掩盖检查状态之外的语义错误、未覆盖路径、工具或 API 漂移、评审偏差、公开任务污染，或脚手架带来的捷径。不要把 benchmark 读成通用验证器，也不要未经单独审计就当成奖励信号。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Retain task id, domain, difficulty vector, website files, ground truth, solution steps, action trace, browser runtime, and judge version.

The card is useful as an evaluation-surface schema: it tells the reader what input, trajectory, output, scorer, and provenance fields must survive if the work is reused for benchmarking, filtering, analysis, or supervised training. Its value for the collection is the explicit feedback contract, not only the headline score.

复用时要保留任务编号、领域、难度向量、网站文件、标准答案、解题步骤、动作轨迹、浏览器运行时和评审器版本。

这张卡适合当作评测面 schema 使用：它说明如果下游要复用该工作进行评测、过滤、分析或监督训练，哪些输入、轨迹、输出、评分器和来源字段必须保留下来。它对库的价值在明确反馈契约，而不只是标题里的分数。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
Read WebForge as a generated-environment benchmark, not as evidence that generated websites fully substitute for live web evaluation.

Read the official paper first, then inspect the repository or dataset release. Keep data construction, model training, evaluation harness, judge/verifier, and leaderboard numbers separate. If a license, split, snapshot, or judge version is not pinned, treat comparisons as provisional.

应把 WebForge 读成生成式环境评测，而不是“生成网站完全替代真实在线网页”的证明。

阅读顺序是先看官方论文，再看代码仓库或数据发布。要把数据构造、模型训练、评测框架、评审器或验证器、排行榜数字分开。如果许可、划分、快照或评审器版本没有固定，比较结论就只能视为暂定。
